This test checks that completion works immediately after a dot
in a selector expression when the AST is broken due to a syntax error.
See https://github.com/golang/go/issues/65529.

-- skip --
Not yet implemented: selector completion immediately after dot in broken AST.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.test

go 1.21

-- dot_pkg.go --
package main

import "math"

func main() {
	math.Sqrt(, 0)
	math. //@complete(re"\\.()", "Abs", "Sqrt")
}

-- dot_field.go --
package main

import "fmt"

type Foo struct {
	BarInt int
}

func main() {
	f := Foo{}
	fmt.Println(, 0)
	f. //@complete(re"\\.()", "BarInt")
}
